text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali discusses with Equipment Minister Ali Chaouch projects for the building of 2,500 km (1,600 miles) of roads during the next five years.
- Tunisia and Libya decide to organise more meetings between businessmen from the two countries.
- Communications Minister Habib Ammar returns from Sweden where he held talks with Swedish officials on cooperation in the telecommunications sector.
